hooks.command: p=$(jq -r ".tool_input.file_path // empty"); case "$p" in *candlebench/*.py) m=$(basename "$p" .py); d=$(dirname "$p"); case "$d" in */candlebench) mod="candlebench.$m";; */candlebench/*) mod="candlebench.$(basename "$d").$m";; *) exit 0;; esac; cd "${p%%/candlebench/*}" || exit 0; out=$(python3 -c "import $mod" 2>&1) || { printf "%s\n" "$out" | tail -3 >&2; exit 2; };; esac; exit 0
